shared_elements: low-relief carved figures on a stone surface
horizontal registers/bands stacking figures one above another
human or anthropomorphic figures in profile with raised limbs
justification: Both surfaces organise profile quadrupeds and figures into stacked horizontal registers separated by banded lines, and both rely on shallow relief carving rather than paint for their imagery. But A is a single weathered monolith with a few large, schematic, rounded animal forms, while B is a small, densely detailed and finely modelled panel including architecture, sky colour and an elaborate ornamental frame — an entirely different scale, finish and presentation.
